_meta._note: Cyber benchmark research for non-OpenAI frontier models (Mythos / Opus 4.7 / Sonnet 4.6 / Opus 4.6 / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Gemini 3 Pro / Grok 4.20 / Grok 4.3). Strict primary-source attribution: only ingest if source explicitly names model + benchmark + numeric value. Sources investigated: (1) UK AISI blogs on Mythos and GPT-5.5 cyber capabilities — already ingested via apr30_aisi and aisi_gpt55 batches (Mythos/Opus 4.7 advanced expert avg, TLO completions, narrow cyber, sabotage, etc.). (2) Anthropic system cards (Mythos / Opus 4.7 / Opus 4.6 / Sonnet 4.6) — Mythos card already mined for cybench/cybergym/firefox_147; Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 cards confirmed via primary-source PDFs from www-cdn.anthropic.com (sha 0dd86507... and 78073f73...). (3) Anthropic Mythos blog (red.anthropic.com) — already mined. (4) Fluid Attacks / BenchLM mention Opus 4.7 CyberGym=73.1% — but not present in red.anthropic.com or any Anthropic primary text accessible to us; existing DB value of 24.5% from cybergym.io leaderboard is itself a primary source and we keep it. SKIPPED 73.1% under strict-attribution. (5) Google DeepMind Gemini 3 Pro / 3.1 Pro model cards + FSF report — only state '11/12 hard challenges solved' for Gemini 3 Pro internal CTF (Google's proprietary eval, not mapped to our DB benchmarks like cybench/cybergym/cvebench). No Cybench/CyberGym/CVE-Bench numbers published for Gemini 3 Pro or 3.1 Pro. (6) xAI Grok 4.20 / 4.3 — no model card published as of May 2026 (per artificialanalysis.ai); no Cybench/CyberGym/AIRTBench numbers published. NEW SCORES: only Sonnet 4.6 cybench (pass@30 saturated, pass@1 average) explicitly stated in Sonnet 4.6 system card section 6.4.7 and not yet in DB. All other gaps blocked by missing primary attribution.
